title_en: Fall 2026 Registration for Prerequisite-Designated Courses: Programming Methodology and Basic Electromagnetics
summary: Students who wish to take Programming Methodology (430.211) or Basic Electromagnetics and Lab (430.202B) in Fall 2026 must register according to their admission year and whether they have completed the prerequisite course. Students who have completed the prerequisite register directly on the course registration website during the course registration period. Eligible students who must use the Google Form (mainly 2019-and-earlier admits without the prerequisite) must submit it between 1 September (Tue) 09:00 and 3 September (Thu) 18:00 and adjust their allowable credit limit by 3 September.
applies_to: All students who wish to take the prerequisite-designated courses Programming Methodology (430.211, section 001) or Basic Electromagnetics and Lab (430.202B, sections 001–003) in Fall 2026. Students admitted in 2020 or later who have not completed the prerequisite course may not register at all. The Google Form is only for: (a) Programming Methodology: students admitted in 2019 or earlier who have not completed the prerequisite and who, as of Fall 2026, are in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering undergraduate program (major or second major: double major/minor), the College of Liberal Studies with Electrical and Computer Engineering as major, or the Interdisciplinary Programs in AI Semiconductor Engineering, Intelligent Communications, or Artificial Intelligence; (b) Basic Electromagnetics and Lab: students who, as of Fall 2026, are in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering undergraduate program (major or second major: double major/minor), the College of Liberal Studies with Electrical and Computer Engineering as major, or the Interdisciplinary Program in AI Semiconductor Engineering, and who either were admitted in 2019 or earlier and have not completed the prerequisite, or were admitted in 2020 or later and have completed Advanced Physics 2 or General Physics and Lab 2.

conditions: Students admitted in 2020 or later who have not completed the prerequisite course cannot register through either the course registration website or the Google Form.
Students admitted in 2020 or later who completed Advanced Physics 2 or General Physics and Lab 2 have a recognised prerequisite but cannot register on the website and must use the Google Form.
Google Form applications from students who are not eligible will be cancelled without notice.
The Google Form is not first-come, first-served, and the deadline is strictly enforced.
Approved Google Form applications are accepted even if the section is already full.
Only one section per course may be requested; applying for several sections of the same course at once makes the application invalid.
The request form can be submitted only once (one login); to change it after submission, contact the department office (contact details are in the original notice).
Abbreviations and informal terms may not be used on the form (for example for college, department, or student ID number).
Applicants must keep their allowable credit limit high enough by 3 September so the course can be entered; otherwise it cannot be added.
Personal information collected is used only to process the request form.
The list of prerequisite-designated courses and their prerequisites (Section 1 of the notice) was not included in the text and was not read; check the original notice.
steps: Website registration: If you have completed the prerequisite course (any admission year), register directly on the course registration website during the course registration period.

Google Form registration: Confirm that you meet the eligibility conditions for the specific course (program, admission year, and prerequisite status); check Section 1 of the original notice for the prerequisite list, which was not read.

Google Form registration: Between 1 September (Tue) 09:00 and 3 September (Thu) 18:00, complete and submit the 'Prerequisite-Designated Course Registration Request Form' (선이수 지정 교과목 수강신청 요청서) at https://forms.gle/m4bCo2YLia9Uucrp6 (Chrome recommended), choosing only one section per course and writing college, department and student ID in full without abbreviations.
Google Form registration: By 3 September (Thu), adjust your allowable credit limit (수강신청가능 학점) so that adding the course will not exceed it.
Google Form registration: If you need to correct your submitted form, contact the department office (contact details are in the original notice).
Google Form registration: After the department review on 4 September, check that the course has been entered into your registration by 7 September (Mon) 18:00.
translation:
Fall 2026 Registration for Prerequisite-Designated Courses ('Programming Methodology', 'Basic Electromagnetics and Lab')

For the prerequisite-designated courses below, our department does not allow students admitted in 2020 or later to register unless they meet the prerequisite requirement.

Whether the prerequisite requirement applies, and how to register, differ by admission year (2019 or earlier / 2020 or later). Please be sure to check the information below and register using the method that applies to you.

① Students admitted in 2019 or earlier (up to the 2019 cohort): the prerequisite requirement does not apply
- Students who have completed the prerequisite course: register directly on the course registration website during the course registration period
- Students who have not completed the prerequisite course: apply via Google Form during the over-quota (정원 외) application period

② Students admitted in 2020 or later (from the 2020 cohort): the prerequisite requirement applies
- Students who have completed the prerequisite course: register directly on the course registration website during the course registration period
- Students who have not completed the prerequisite course: registration is not possible either through the course registration website or through the Google Form

Note: Students admitted in 2020 or later who have completed 'Advanced Physics 2' (고급물리학 2) or 'General Physics and Lab 2' (일반물리학 및 실험 2) are recognised as having completed the prerequisite, but they cannot register on the course registration website, so they must apply via Google Form during the over-quota application period.

※ If a student who is not eligible applies through the Google Form, the application will be cancelled without separate notice. Please take care to avoid any disadvantage.

1. Prerequisite-designated courses (applies from the 2020 cohort)
[The content of this section (likely a table or image) was not included in the text and was not read.]

2. Prerequisite-designated courses offered in Fall 2026
- Programming Methodology (프로그래밍방법론) / 430.211 (001)
- Basic Electromagnetics and Lab (기초전자기학 및 연습) / 430.202B (001–003)

*** Please note that the information below is for Google Form applicants ***

3. Eligible applicants
- Programming Methodology: As of Fall 2026, students in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering undergraduate program (major + second major (double major/minor)), the College of Liberal Studies (with Electrical and Computer Engineering as major), the Interdisciplinary Program in AI Semiconductor Engineering, the Interdisciplinary Program in Intelligent Communications, or the Interdisciplinary Program in Artificial Intelligence, who were admitted in 2019 or earlier (up to the 2019 cohort) and have not completed the prerequisite course.
- Basic Electromagnetics and Lab: As of Fall 2026, students in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering undergraduate program (major + second major (double major/minor)), the College of Liberal Studies (with Electrical and Computer Engineering as major), or the Interdisciplinary Program in AI Semiconductor Engineering, who were admitted in 2019 or earlier (up to the 2019 cohort) and have not completed the prerequisite course, or who were admitted in 2020 or later and have completed 'Advanced Physics 2' or 'General Physics and Lab 2'.

4. Application method and procedure
- Method: Complete and submit the 'Prerequisite-Designated Course Registration Request Form (Google Form)' (선이수 지정 교과목 수강신청 요청서)
※ Link: https://forms.gle/m4bCo2YLia9Uucrp6 (Chrome browser recommended)
- Application period: 1 September (Tue) 09:00 – 3 September (Thu) 18:00 (not first-come, first-served; the deadline is strictly enforced)
- Department review and approval: 4 September (Fri) 09:00–18:00
- System entry: The department will enter registrations manually by 7 September (Mon) 18:00
※ Applicants must adjust their allowable credit limit (수강신청가능 학점) by 3 September (Thu) so that it is not exceeded and the course can be entered.

5. Important notes
- Sections requested by eligible Google Form applicants will be approved even if the section is full (however, applying for multiple sections of the same course at the same time will be treated as invalid).
- Only one section per course may be submitted; you may not apply for multiple sections of the same course.
- The 'Prerequisite-Designated Course Registration Request Form' can be submitted only once (one login). If you wish to make changes after submitting, contact the department office and it can be corrected.
- Abbreviations and informal/new terms may not be used on the request form (* e.g. college, department, student ID number).
- Personal information collected will be used only for processing the request form.

6. Inquiries: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering undergraduate office (contact details are in the original notice).
